clips.title: The story
paras: Following the Sigil of Trollbane, Zengu finds that the four sigils have formed a single one that can break the wardings on Trollbane's tomb. He sends you to Stromgarde to retrieve Trol'kalar from the tomb.

Zengu finds that the four sigils have come together and formed one, the Sigil of Ignaeus. He has no doubt it can break the wardings placed on Trollbane's tomb. Trollbane lies entombed in Stromgarde, in the Sanctum that lies behind the chapel, and Zengu sends you there to retrieve Trol'kalar. A fenced path beside the chapel entrance, on its right, descends to the crypt.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: What's this? With the four sigils brought together, they have formed together to create one sigil. There can be no doubt that this will be able to break the wardings placed upon Trollbane's tomb.
Trollbane's remains are entombed in the Sanctum behind the chapel in Stromgarde. Retrieve Trol'kalar.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Etchings in the stone upon the face of the tomb of Trollbane match the glowing lines of the Sigil of Ignaeus...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Matching the lines on the face of Trollbane's tomb with the glowing lines of the Sigil of Ignaeus, a flash of light consumes the Sigil, and the legendary sword Trol'kalar is released from the stone hands' grip.
